_instructions: Copy the 'Validate_Auth_Token' scope below into your flow's Main_Flow.actions. Place it after Validate_Input and before your business logic. Update runAfter to match your preceding action name if different. Also add 'authToken' to your flow's trigger schema (see _trigger_schema_addition).

authToken.description: Auth token from OTP verification. Required for all authenticated flows.

Validate_Auth_Token.description:
Validates the caller's auth token against the Dataverse sessions table. Returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED + Terminate(Succeeded) if the token is missing, unknown, or expired.

ROW-LEVEL SECURITY — CRITICAL:
After both If conditions pass, the token is valid. The trusted user identity is:
  @first(body('IMPLEMENT_Get_Auth_Session')?['value'])?['[IMPLEMENT]:smkb_sol_userid']

Always use this expression — NOT triggerBody()?['userId'] — for all Dataverse queries and writes.
This prevents a caller with a valid token from reading or updating another user's data.

Example: to restrict a ListRecords call to the authenticated user's own row:
  $filter: "smkb_sol_userid eq '@{first(body('IMPLEMENT_Get_Auth_Session')?['value'])?['smkb_sol_userid']}'"

Note: the 401 responses here terminate with runStatus: Succeeded so Handle_Flow_Error does NOT run — an invalid token is an expected condition, not a bug.

IMPLEMENT_Get_Auth_Session.description: Look up the session record by token. [IMPLEMENT]: (1) replace entityName with your session table plural name (e.g. smkb_sol_sessions). (2) replace smkb_sol_token in $filter with your token field schema name.

If_Token_Not_Found.description: No session record for this token — caller is unauthenticated or presented a forged/expired token. Return 401 + Terminate(Succeeded).

If_Token_Expired.description:
Token exists but its expiry timestamp is in the past. Return 401 + Terminate(Succeeded). [IMPLEMENT]: replace smkb_sol_expires_at with your expiry field schema name.

Note: this action only runs when If_Token_Not_Found succeeded — meaning the token WAS found. If it was not found, If_Token_Not_Found terminates the run before reaching here.

Respond_token_expired.description: Return 401 Unauthorized for an expired token.
